query:
SELECT d.attendeeId, d.firstName, d.lastName, d.company,
       m.id AS meetingId, m.sponsorId, m.timeSlot, m.status,
       s.companyName AS sponsorCompany
FROM delegateProfiles d
JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = d.attendeeId
JOIN sponsors s ON m.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE d.firstName LIKE '%Oliver%'
AND s.companyName LIKE '%Wilson%';
